text:
maria: quick brain-dump — thinking we should add explicit progress markers + a priority-hint wire signal at the gateway so clients can gracefully degrade UI instead of just timing out. want to capture tradeoffs and an incremental plan. :thinking_face:
akshay: +1. can you sketch the surface? is this a header, trailers, or an inline event stream?

maria: idea: a lightweight header + occasional progress events on streaming responses. header example: `Priority-Hint: low|normal|high` and `X-Redwood-Progress: enable=true` for opt-in. progress events would be sparse (e.g., stage=tokenized, partial=50%, model=small-fallback) so we don't wire a ton of traffic.

dom: love it. couple concerns: 1) ordering/consistency — if proxy forwards a cached prefix then progress events may mislead; 2) backpressure admission — we need to tie progress semantics to admission decisions (i.e., low-priority streams can get coarser progress).
oklivia: fyi on metrics side: we should attach progress_stage and last_progress_ts tags to spans so we can alert when clients see no progress for > Xs. also useful for regressions when a rollout causes stalls.
maria: agree. proposal for minimal viable: header semantics + gateway emits periodic progress trailers (not full chunking) for streaming clients that opted-in. non-streaming clients get a final status header if fallback happened.
akshay: how do we surface to SDKs? SDKs could map Priority-Hint -> client retry/backoff policy and show a sticky spinner vs skeleton. serverside, gateway uses priority to decide eviction vs queue. suggestion: admission score = base_score - penalty(priority=low) - age_factor.
dom: eviction rules need bounds: don't evict a midflight high-priority call just because a burst of high-priority arrived. maybe a soft-share: reserve N% qps for high-priority, and low-priority can be preempted only if admission falls below threshold. also define what progress means semantically: 0=queued, 1=started, 2=first-token, 3=partial, 4=final.
maria: good taxonomy. we should also include a progress_id so UIs can correlate multiple partial responses (e.g., refetch after fallback). sample event:```\n{\n  "progress_id": "abc123",\n  "stage": "partial",\n  "partial_pct": 42,\n  "model_variant": "redwood-small-fallback"\n}\n```

olivia: small ask — include sampling flags so we don't blow up metrics cardinality. progress_id + stage are ok, partial_pct should be coarse buckets (0,25,50,75,100). annotate with model_variant only on transitions.
maria: agreed. operational plan: 1) add headers and opt-in flag in gateway (feature flag behind `progress-v1`), 2) implement sparse progress events (every ~2s or on stage change), 3) SDKs read Priority-Hint and toggle UI affordances, 4) metrics: track progress_emitted, progress_gap_count, percent_within_slo.
akshay: how about retries? should a retry reset progress_id? my vote: yes, increment attempt counter in progress_id (abc123-1, abc123-2) so UI can show "attempting fallback" and we can attribute.
dom: also consider interaction with KV caching/prefix caching — if gateway serves from cache then emit a quick `stage=final` with model_variant=cache-hit and partial_pct=100. Helps clients not show long spinner.
maria: security/privacy note — progress events could leak timing info for sensitive workloads. default should be opt-out (client must opt-in). also strip progress for private deployments unless enabled.
olivia: agree on opt-in. TL;DR on observability: add span tags `progress.stage`, `progress.attempt`, `progress.variant`, and metric counters `progress.emitted`, `progress.missing`. sample alert: `p95 time to first progress > 2s` for high-priority routes.
akshay: short-term: prototype on a single, low-risk route (chat-beta) with feature flag and SDK hook. measure false positives and noise for 1 week. if okay, expand routing and add admission rules.
maria: owner: @akshay will prototype headers and gateway emission. @olivia will wire metrics. dom will draft eviction soft-share numbers. i'll write the RFC follow-up with concrete enum values and backpressure algorithm (admission formula).

deploy-bot: deploy triggered for feature/progress-v1 to staging at 1743219998 — CI passed. :rocket:
akshay: thanks — will push a short README for SDKs on how to opt-in and interpret progress_id.
maria: cool — filing RFC follow-up with proposed API enums and backward compatibility notes. will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
